instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Commercial property management firm operating 12 office buildings, 3 retail centers, and 2 logistics parks totaling 120,000 m² of leasable area. Managing 400+ tenant relationships. Seeking to implement IoT-based building energy management and a tenant experience mobile app. We operate across multiple locations and have distinct functional leadership for operations, commercial, finance, and technology. Our annual planning process is well-established but can be rigid — mid-cycle innovation funding requires navigating a formal business case approval chain involving 3-4 stakeholders.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. The project was cross-functional involving product, compliance, and customer success teams. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has challenged us to improve EBITDA margins by 500 basis points within 3 years. This requires a disciplined, data-driven approach to identifying cost drivers and process bottlenecks. We are open to technology investment if it demonstrably reduces unit costs or eliminates manual touchpoints, but every project must have a clear ROI timeline of under 12 months.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.
answers.additionalContext: We completed a merger with a similarly-sized competitor 4 months ago and are in the middle of integrating teams, systems, and processes. The combined organization has significant duplication — two CRMs, two HR systems, overlapping product lines. There is a unique window to redesign processes from scratch rather than patching legacy approaches, but cultural integration is fragile and change fatigue is real.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 6 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Unified Operational Platform and Process Redesign (Post-Merger)
opportunities.rationale: The merger presents a rare window to eliminate systemic process duplication, but this requires treating the entire operational structure as a blank slate. Focus must shift from patching two CRMs/HR systems to building one core data repository and standardized workflow layer.

first_actions: Conduct a full Gap Analysis comparing current state (duplication) vs. desired unified state for key processes (CRM, HR, Operations).
Establish a dedicated 'Process Redesign Task Force' comprising leaders from both merged entities.
Define the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) feature set for the single source of truth system.
resources_needed: Executive sponsorship with clear mandate to decommission legacy systems.
execution_plan.success_metric: Decommissioning rate of redundant systems (e.g., 1 CRM retired within 6 months).
milestones: Process Blueprint finalized and approved by executive committee.
Single Source of Truth data model operationalized.
Pilot launch of core unified process (e.g., client intake) in one location.

opportunities.title: Predictive Asset Utilization and Energy Cost Reduction Program
opportunities.rationale: This opportunity directly addresses the board's EBITDA mandate by focusing on tangible, quantifiable cost reduction within the physical assets. Leveraging IoT data (as planned) allows for predictive maintenance scheduling and optimized energy use.

first_actions: Identify 2-3 pilot properties with high energy consumption to test the model.
Integrate existing building management system (BMS) data streams with historical utility costs.
Develop a granular cost attribution model linking operational data points to specific unit cost savings.
resources_needed: Data science engineer time dedicated to time-series modeling.
execution_plan.success_metric: Demonstrable reduction in energy consumption (kWh) or maintenance costs ($) at pilot sites by 5% within 6 months.
milestones: Model V1 built and validated with historical data.
Pilot deployment of monitoring tools at first site.
ROI calculation presented to finance committee.

next_steps.action: Executive Steering Committee meeting focused solely on approving the scope and budget for the 'Process Redesign Task Force' (Opp 1).
Finalize the data requirements and API access needed for predictive modeling, specifically identifying key cost drivers from existing asset management records.
Conduct targeted workshops with long-tenured employees (both merged entities) to map 'shadow processes'—the manual workarounds they currently use due to system gaps.

key_weaknesses: Systemic duplication and lack of unified data governance post-merger, creating high operational risk and cost waste.
Cultural integration remains a soft blocker; resistance to fundamental process change is high and requires specialized change management.
Difficulty in quantifying the ROI for large, preventative structural investments due to current siloed historical cost data.

improvements: Successfully launched a digital customer onboarding flow, proving cross-functional execution and achieving measurable NPS lift.
Formalization of strategic planning processes has reduced ad-hoc decision-making.
Increased budget allocation (12%) provides necessary capital backing for larger transformation efforts.
persistent_gaps: The core systems remain fragmented, preventing a single view of the tenant lifecycle or operational cost center.
Lack of consensus on which legacy system/process should be officially sunsetted vs. optimized.
The merger's organizational complexity requires systemic architectural solutions, not merely localized fixes.
achieved_milestones: Improved customer onboarding efficiency (12 days to 5 days).
Identification of key cross-functional stakeholders for process improvement efforts.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Shift from general 'process streamlining' to highly targeted, system-level overhauls driven by significant merger activity and a clear EBITDA profitability mandate.
